text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a few days before the Mainichi Hai,
but with
the Satsuki Sho on the horizon,
talks naturally
turn to that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is a clash of greats.
Racers to
look out for include... There's
no mention of me
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly. I'm sure opinions will
change
after the Mainichi Hai at any
rate.
choice_data_list_en: Are you concerned about what people think?
Are you concerned about what people think?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Rather, I must make them change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than be discouraged by the lack
of
recognition, Yaeno Muteki seems to
have been
motivated to do better
instead. I can't help but
admire that
about her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think I should be most wary
of in the
Mainichi Hai?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is one of Yaeno Muteki's
classmates,
hailing from Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her talent has already garnered much
attention,
earning her a reputation as a
skilled racer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the public thinks very highly of
Oguri,
and I can tell she possesses great
prowess just
from watching her train.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The mightier the foe I face, the
more
excited I become.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall subdue her! Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the day of the Mainichi Hai...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's Oguri Cap. They say she's
got a real
shot at winning even graded
races!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! I came from Kasamatsu to cheer
for you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you so much. That means a
lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Oguri seems the same as always. I don't
sense
any kind of overwhelming threat
from her...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Her actual presence is at complete
odds with her
reputation and strength.
Be that as it may, I have
no intention of
letting my guard down.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All I must focus on is controlling the
blaze fierce
with water still.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall win this race and then make a
name for
myself at the Satsuki Sho!
